input.quote: Licensee acknowledges that the grant of the license set forth in this Section is a non-exclusive license and that the Licensor shall have the right to use and to license to other parties the Licensed Technology for any purpose and in any manner as Licensor may determine in its sole discretion.
input.rationale: The arrangement is expressly non-exclusive in both directions; there is no sole-supplier, all-requirements or "shall not procure from any third party" obligation on us. The "Right of First Refusal" in Article XXII concerns a sale of our business (addressed under ASSIGN), not procurement exclusivity. No redline required for this rule.

input.quote: II. As compensation for the Licensee to use the Licensed Technology during the Initial Period, Licensee shall pay to Licensor, the following user fees:
input.rationale: Pricing is a fixed volume-tiered rate card with a 15% rebate and revenue-share ("Supplemental Payments"); there is no obligation on us to extend to Licensor terms no less favourable than those given to third parties, and no matching obligation. Nothing to redline (we may separately seek an MFN in our favour as a commercial ask).

input.quote: During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
input.rationale: The non-solicit is one-way against us, runs three years post-termination (beyond our 24-month walk-away) and covers all Licensor and Affiliate employees rather than those involved in the engagement. The general-advertising carve-out is fine. Redline makes it mutual, 12 months, limited to personnel directly involved.
